Title: Azure AD access reviews is now available

Body.Content: Azure AD access reviews helps you ensure that employees and partners have the right access to the right resources by giving you the visibility and control over access. Access reviews also alleviates the attestation fatigue IT admins experience and streamlines employee and partners access to resources. To help you scale your access review efforts, admins can organize access reviews into programs grouped by app and group and set up recurrence so reviews run automatically at the desired frequency. In addition, system recommendations for monitoring and auto applying of review decisions also help when it comes to larger organizations in ensuring user access is always up to date. To learn more, read the full blog post and get started with the documentation today!
